title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Tool Rental Volume: Added Engine Hours on Ridgeline Tool Rental
content:
Renters who run their tool rentals through a Ridgeline Pro Credit account receive added engine hours on metered Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment.

**Rule.** Pro Credit rental volume adds hours to the engine hours included: when the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account carries 4 or more tool rental invoices posted in the last 12 months, 8 hours are added; when it carries 1 to 3 such invoices, 4 hours are added; when it carries none, no hour is added.

**Which invoices count.** The invoices on the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account whose purchase channel is tool rental, each dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the engine overtime charge is billed.

The added hours count as engine hours included, so they are taken off the engine hours used along with the rest of the included hours before overtime hours are counted.

## Volume table

| Tool rental invoices on the Ridgeline Pro Credit account in the last 12 months | Hours added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 8 |
| 1, 2 or 3 | 4 |
| none | 0 |

## Hypothetical readings (charge billed on 2 October 2026)

| Tool rental invoices dated | Counted | Hours added |
|---|---|---|
| 5 January, 2 March, 18 June, 9 September 2026 | 4 | 8 |
| 3 October 2025, 14 August 2026 | 2 | 4 |
| 2 October 2025 only | 0 (12 whole months before) | 0 |

Invoices for other purchases on the account, such as building materials, are not tool rental invoices and do not count.
